phrases.english: we want them to spend more time working at home
phrases.other: ŷn ni'n moyn iddyn nhw hala mwy o amser yn gweithio gytre
phrases.qa_notes: Natural in both languages. Good South Welsh forms: 'hala' (spend), 'gytre' (home), 'moyn' (want).

phrases.english: do you want something?
phrases.other: ŷch chi'n moyn rhywbeth?
phrases.qa_notes: Simple, natural, useful. Correct formal 'you' form with South 'moyn'.

phrases.english: but I want to practice speaking
phrases.other: ond dw i'n moyn ymarfer siarad
phrases.qa_notes: Perfect. Pedagogically meta-relevant for language learners. Natural in both languages.

phrases.english: do they want to spend more time meeting as a group?
phrases.other: ŷn nhw'n moyn hala mwy o amser yn cwrdd fel grŵp?
phrases.qa_notes: Good Welsh. English slightly formal/workplace-ish but acceptable.

phrases.english: on Monday morning
phrases.other: fore dydd Llun
phrases.qa_notes: Useful time expression. Correct soft mutation. Natural fragment.

phrases.english: the film had finished already
phrases.other: oedd y ffilm 'di cwpla yn barod
phrases.qa_notes: Natural tense usage. Good colloquial South Welsh ''di cwpla'.

phrases.english: I want to learn
phrases.other: dw i'n moyn dysgu
phrases.qa_notes: Perfect core BUILD phrase. Essential beginner expression. Natural in both languages.

phrases.english: the two girls are wanting some sleep
phrases.other: mae'r ddwy ferch yn moyn bach o gwsg
phrases.qa_notes: ISSUE: English 'are wanting' is unnatural - stative verbs don't typically take continuous form. Should be 'the two girls want some sleep'. Welsh is fine.

phrases.english: yes, we've got one boy and the girl there
phrases.other: oes, ma 'da ni un bachgen a'r ferch yna
phrases.qa_notes: Functional but 'the girl there' in English sounds slightly odd (why 'the' specifically?). Welsh is natural South form.

phrases.english: I'm from England
phrases.other: dw i'n dod o Loegr
phrases.qa_notes: Essential phrase. Perfect with correct soft mutation on Lloegr. Natural in both languages.

phrases.english: you'd better not go out tonight
phrases.other: well i ti beidio mynd mas heno
phrases.qa_notes: Good idiomatic expression. Natural 'well i ti' construction with South 'mas'.

phrases.english: we want to be ready tomorrow
phrases.other: ŷn ni'n moyn bod yn barod yfory
phrases.qa_notes: Good practical phrase. Natural in both languages.

phrases.english: I watched the football and I had a glass or two of water
phrases.other: wnes i wylio'r pêl-droed a ges i wydred neu ddau o ddŵr
phrases.qa_notes: Semantically unusual - 'a glass or two of water' is an odd phrase. People say this about wine/beer, not water. Welsh grammar is correct.

phrases.english: you speak Welsh well
phrases.other: ti'n siarad Cymraeg yn dda
phrases.qa_notes: Perfect BUILD phrase. Useful compliment for learners. Natural in both languages.

phrases.english: I was speaking with someone who said that she likes that film
phrases.other: o'n i'n siarad gyda rhywun ddwedodd bod hi'n hoffi'r ffilm 'na
phrases.qa_notes: Good complex sentence with relative clause. Natural in both languages.

phrases.english: someone who told me that you want to read that book today
phrases.other: rhywun ddwedodd wrtha i bod ti'n moyn darllen y llyfr 'na heddiw
phrases.qa_notes: Fragment structure - no main verb for 'someone' in English. Less natural as standalone. Welsh matches the fragment structure.

phrases.english: the youngest has just started at school
phrases.other: mae'r ifancaf newydd ddechrau yn yr ysgol
phrases.qa_notes: Natural family context phrase. Good use of superlative. Natural in both languages.

phrases.english: that is what you've done
phrases.other: dyna be' ti 'di gwneud
phrases.qa_notes: Good emphatic construction. Natural colloquial Welsh 'be'' for 'beth'.

phrases.english: I'd tell you if I could remember
phrases.other: bydden i'n dweud wrthot ti 'sen i'n gallu cofio
phrases.qa_notes: Good conditional practice. Natural conditional construction in both languages.

phrases.english: if I could drink something
phrases.other: 'sen i'n gallu yfed rhywbeth
phrases.qa_notes: Incomplete conditional fragment. Pedagogically useful for practicing conditional form but incomplete as standalone.

phrases.english: their baby
phrases.other: eu babi
phrases.qa_notes: Simple BUILD phrase for possessive. Useful vocabulary. Natural noun phrase.

phrases.english: I'm not sure if I can
phrases.other: dw i ddim yn siŵr os galla i
phrases.qa_notes: Very useful conversational hedging phrase. Natural in both languages.

phrases.english: the heart
phrases.other: y galon
phrases.qa_notes: Simple vocabulary BUILD. Correct soft mutation after article.

phrases.english: don't take too much of a risk
phrases.other: paid â chymryd gormod o risg
phrases.qa_notes: Good idiomatic expression. Natural imperative with correct aspirate mutation.

phrases.english: why do you want to go to play together?
phrases.other: pam ŷch chi'n moyn mynd i chwarae gyda'ch gilydd?
phrases.qa_notes: Register mismatch - 'go to play' is childish but 'ŷch chi' is formal. English slightly awkward.

phrases.english: she said that she needed to ask you something today
phrases.other: ddwedodd hi bo' hi angen gofyn rhywbeth i ti heddiw
phrases.qa_notes: Good reported speech. Natural with colloquial 'bo''.

phrases.english: I know someone who likes that film
phrases.other: dw i'n nabod rhywun sy'n hoffi'r ffilm 'na
phrases.qa_notes: Good natural phrase with relative clause. Natural in both languages.

phrases.english: I didn't do a lot on Saturday afternoon
phrases.other: wnes i ddim gwneud llawer bnawn dydd Sadwrn
phrases.qa_notes: Natural weekend conversation. Good use of 'bnawn' (afternoon).

phrases.english: to be more open
phrases.other: bod yn fwy agored
phrases.qa_notes: Good infinitive construction. Natural phrase fragment.

phrases.english: I'd rather talk with my brother
phrases.other: byddai'n well 'da fi siarad gyda fy mrawd i
phrases.qa_notes: Good preference expression. Natural South Welsh 'well 'da fi' construction.

phrases.english: an old man who told me that he wants to watch that film today
phrases.other: hen ddyn ddwedodd wrtha i fod e'n moyn gwylio'r ffilm 'na heddiw
phrases.qa_notes: Good but quite long. Natural with correct mutations. Fragment structure.

phrases.english: imagine myself having a problem
phrases.other: dychmygu fy hunan yn cael problem
phrases.qa_notes: Semantically odd fragment - unusual thing to say in isolation. Grammatically correct but contextually awkward in both languages.

phrases.english: I don't want to tell you until I finish this
phrases.other: sa i'n moyn dweud wrthot ti nes i fi gwpla hwn
phrases.qa_notes: Good temporal clause. Natural South Welsh 'sa i'n' and 'cwpla'.

phrases.english: we wanted to give it to him today
phrases.other: o'n ni'n moyn rhoi e iddo fe heddiw
phrases.qa_notes: Good natural phrase with pronoun redundancy (fe). Natural in both languages.

phrases.english: would you like to talk about it?
phrases.other: hoffet ti siarad amdani?
phrases.qa_notes: Good conversational opener. Good pronoun agreement (amdani - feminine).

phrases.english: I didn't know how
phrases.other: do'n i ddim yn gwybod sut
phrases.qa_notes: Good BUILD phrase for past tense negative + interrogative. Natural in both languages.

phrases.english: I'd tell you if you'd help
phrases.other: bydden i'n dweud wrthot ti 'set ti'n helpu
phrases.qa_notes: Good double conditional practice. Natural in both languages.

phrases.english: but I can't remember how to say what I wanted to say
phrases.other: ond alla i ddim cofio sut i ddweud beth o'n i'n moyn dweud
phrases.qa_notes: Excellent meta-linguistic phrase. Very useful for learners struggling to express themselves. Natural in both languages.

phrases.english: with a few friends
phrases.other: gyda ychydig o ffrindiau
phrases.qa_notes: Good BUILD phrase for prepositional phrase with quantifier. Natural in both languages.

phrases.english: did you watch it?
phrases.other: wnest ti wylio fe?
phrases.qa_notes: Good BUILD phrase for past tense question. Natural South Welsh with 'fe'.

phrases.english: do you need to ask again?
phrases.other: wyt ti angen gofyn eto?
phrases.qa_notes: Good conversational phrase. Natural in both languages.

phrases.english: my mother doesn't feel like that
phrases.other: dyw fy mam ddim yn teimlo fel hynny
phrases.qa_notes: Good emotional expression. Natural in both languages.

phrases.english: they want us to spend more time at school
phrases.other: maen nhw'n moyn i ni hala mwy o amser yn yr ysgol
phrases.qa_notes: Good complex construction. Natural South Welsh 'hala'.

phrases.english: you didn't tell me it had finished on Thursday
phrases.other: wnest ti ddim dweud wrtha i fod e 'di cwpla ddydd Iau
phrases.qa_notes: Good past tense reported speech. Natural with 'fod e 'di cwpla'.

phrases.english: yes, I'm ready to wait for your sister
phrases.other: ydw, dw i'n barod i aros am dy chwaer di
phrases.qa_notes: Good conversational response. Natural with correct mutations.

phrases.english: I can't practice
phrases.other: alla i ddim ymarfer
phrases.qa_notes: Good BUILD phrase for modal negative. Natural in both languages.

phrases.english: if I asked you to help me deal with the arrangements
phrases.other: 'sen i'n gofyn i ti ʼn helpu fi ddelio gyda'r trefniadau
phrases.qa_notes: Good conditional clause. Minor notation issue with apostrophe in Welsh (ʼn helpu).

phrases.english: milk with your tea
phrases.other: llaeth gyda'ch te
phrases.qa_notes: Simple BUILD phrase. Natural with formal 'your'. Useful hospitality phrase.

phrases.english: you know that I'm always happy to walk to school with you if you like
phrases.other: ti'n gwybod bo' fi wastad yn hapus i gerdded i'r ysgol gyda ti os hoffi di
phrases.qa_notes: Good complex natural sentence. Natural in both languages.

phrases.english: I was going to do the same thing as my father
phrases.other: o'n i'n mynd i wneud yr un peth â fy nhad
phrases.qa_notes: Good past intention expression. Natural with correct nasal mutation on 'tad'.
